issues.detail: The reply_matches '/architect\b[^\n]*recovery' assumes the invocation and its 'active recovery' wording sit on one line. The protocol's template line is a single line, so this is very likely, but a run that wraps the invocation across lines would fail.
issues.fix: Acceptable as written; optionally relax to allow a newline, for example '/architect\b[\s\S]{0,200}recovery'.
